purpose: Teach: ヌード/ピュア/パンドラ/ノア/聖母/ジミー/スーザン/アンディ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、美術館のヌードデッサン展のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi told me a customer was talking about that nude drawing exhibition at the art museum.
lines.style: Warm, thoughtful recall. Speaking softly to herself as much as to Aoi. Gentle smile in the voice. Pause slightly before the main clause, like savoring the memory.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ピュアな心の大切さを語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer was telling me how important it is to keep a pure heart.
lines.style: Reflective, almost wondering aloud. Quiet conviction underneath. Slow, careful pacing — like she's still turning the idea over in her mind. Slight lift at the end, inviting Mei in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ギリシャ神話のパンドラの箱のお話だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and the customer was talking about Pandora's box from Greek mythology.
lines.style: Slightly surprised recall — remembering another thread from the conversation. Warm tone, a little more animated than before. Natural, unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、聖書のノアの方舟のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer shared a story with me about Noah's Ark from the Bible.
lines.style: Steady, reverential tone. Speaking with care about something meaningful. Quiet and measured. Slight pause before the reference, honoring the subject matter.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ラファエロの聖母像がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: So the customer really loves Raphael's Madonna paintings.
lines.style: Delighted recognition. Warmth and appreciation in the voice. Light, conversational pace. Small smile behind the words — pleased to share this detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国コメディアンのジミー・ファロンがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That same customer is a big fan of American comedian Jimmy Fallon.
lines.style: Lighter tone, almost amused. Gentle shift from the reverent mood before — human and relatable. Conversational pace, natural and easy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、英国シンガー、スーザン・ボイルの曲を愛されてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The customer adores Susan Boyle's music — the British singer.
lines.style: Tender admiration in the voice. Slight reverence for genuine talent and heart. Warm, unhurried pacing. Soft trailing on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、米国の俳優アンディ・ガルシアの映画がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And this customer is really into films with Andy García, the American actor.
lines.style: Closing thought, gently wrapped up. Warm and complete. Slight downward inflection at the end, settling the conversation. Soft, contented delivery — no rush.
